mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and reduce blood pressure through different mechanisms; torsemide causes volume depletion via loop diuresis while olmesartan blocks angiotensin II receptors, creating additive hypotensive effects and potential electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess renal function and electrolytes regularly, educate patient on orthostatic hypotension symptoms, and consider dose adjustments if excessive hypotension or renal impairment develops.
